ledger: woman in dark teal dress | walks through kitchen into bedroom on the right | walks out of bedroom doorway into a second morphed kitchen | continuous tracking shot

kitchen and house layout | microwave on right counter, stove on left, framed floral art beside bedroom doorway | duplicated floral art inside bedroom, impossible exterior window on interior wall, second kitchen with microwave above stove on left | impossible geometry and morphing between 00:05 and 00:09

findings.description: After the woman turns right from the kitchen into the bedroom at 00:03–00:04, the wall to her left at 00:05 features an exterior window looking outdoors right where the adjacent interior kitchen/hallway should be located. As the camera continues panning left at 00:06–00:07, the framed floral artwork from the kitchen wall (00:01) appears duplicated inside the bedroom to the left of the doorway.

As the woman walks through the bedroom doorway between 00:07 and 00:09, the space ahead morphs into a second, altered version of the kitchen: the multi-pane glass window on the far door at 00:07 changes into a dark single panel by 00:09, and a stove with an over-the-range microwave appears on the left wall (contradicting the kitchen at 00:00 where the microwave was on the right countertop).
